_about: Judgment calls for each niche from the drop-servicing video (on-screen list + spoken extras). gate: ok = a real business 6 Central could legitimately run or partner into; blocked = cannot hold a legitimate Google profile for it (institution, government, impersonation, mission conflict). fit: 0-10 for 6 Central's portfolio (home/local services, Chicago base, shared dispatch/call/marketing services). license: what to check before any move; 'verify' means not yet confirmed from a primary source.

passenger van rental.model: Own a small fleet or partner with a fleet owner (their profile).
passenger van rental.note: Capital-heavy; a profile without owned vans is lead-gen.

escape room.model: Marketing client only: escape rooms are physical venues with their own profiles.
escape room.note: Can't hold a profile without a venue.

auditions.note: Not a service business; a listing would mislead people looking for real casting calls.

golf courses.note: A venue you would have to own; a listing otherwise impersonates one.

private equity firms.note: Regulated financial firm; a referral listing would be impersonation.

credit union.note: Chartered institution; cannot be represented by a third party.

homeschool program.model: Real tutoring / homeschool co-op business with instructors.
homeschool program.note: Needs real educators and a curriculum.

passport.note: Government office; private 'passport' listings are a known scam pattern.

grocery delivery.note: Dominated by national apps; thin margins.

airports.note: Public infrastructure; a listing would impersonate it.

makeup artist.model: Mobile glam team (artists as staff/contractors under one accountable brand) or Partner & manage for independent artists.
makeup artist.license: Cosmetology/esthetics licensing varies by state; verify.
makeup artist.note: Wedding and event demand; mobile, home-based.

celebrity hair stylist.model: Only as true premium positioning by a stylist who has celebrity clients.
celebrity hair stylist.note: 'Celebrity' implies a clientele you don't have; tiny search volume.

celebrity nanny agency.model: A real nanny placement agency (drop the 'celebrity' claim).
celebrity nanny agency.license: Placement agencies may need an employment-agency license; verify for Illinois.
celebrity nanny agency.note: 'Nanny agency chicago' has real demand; the celebrity version doesn't.

celebrity personal trainer.license: Certification (no state license in most states).
celebrity personal trainer.note: 170 searches/mo nationally; the real market is plain 'personal trainer'.

celebrity publicist.note: 140/mo nationally; an online, not local, service.

celebrity realtors.license: Real estate license; brokers must hold the listing.

celebrity tours.note: Only works in LA; small volume.

comedians.model: Entertainment booking agency that contracts acts and is accountable for the booking.
comedians.license: Talent agency licensing in some states (e.g. CA); verify.

illustrator.model: Online freelance service, not a map-pack business.

music marketing company.model: Online agency (fits 6 Central's marketing capability, not a local profile play).
music marketing company.note: 90 searches/mo; artists are price-sensitive and often targeted by scams. Requires a clean reputation.

mobile DJ.model: Event-services brand bundling DJ, photo booth and rentals with real staff.

translation services.model: Translation agency with vetted certified translators; the agency signs the work and owns quality.
translation services.license: Certified/sworn translation requirements vary by document; verify.
translation services.note: $6.99 CPC in Chicago; agency subcontracting is normal and disclosed in this industry.

parasailing.model: Operator with boats and licensed captains; marketing client otherwise.
parasailing.license: Passenger-for-hire vessels need USCG-credentialed captains; verify.

adult entertainment.note: Outside 6 Central's mission and brand standards.

call centers.model: A 6 Central call-handling / dispatch company serving its own portfolio first, then outside clients. Needs a real staffed location for a map listing; otherwise market it online.
call centers.license: TCPA and telemarketing rules for any outbound calling.
call centers.note: $32 CPC nationally: B2B value is high, and it is a shared service the portfolio already needs (TJ's dispatch).

carports.model: Install crew or dealer-installer partnership (metal carport kits), Partner & manage.
carports.license: Permits; contractor rules vary by city.
carports.note: 6,600/mo nationally; strongest in the South and Texas.

room additions.model: Partner & manage with licensed GCs (ties into the decks & GC watch).
room additions.note: $10.07 CPC, KD 3: easy to rank, high ticket.

pool deck resurfacing.model: Partner & manage or a coatings crew (pairs with epoxy garage floors).

patio covers.license: Permits; contractor license in many states.

loctician.model: Partner & manage with licensed loctician studios or salons; the stylist's business holds the profile.
loctician.license: Illinois licenses hair braiders; verify for loc work.

yacht rental.model: Partner with licensed charter operators (their profiles); 6 Central markets them.

movie theater.note: A venue; the video's 'thousands of searches, no competition' claim ignores that people are looking for showtimes.

personal trainer.model: In-home / mobile training brand with certified trainers, or Partner & manage.
